intro.text: Tap a field, then type on the keys. The server keeps the text.
Tap - or + to step. Tap the number to type one on the keypad, then OK.
Tap a key box, then pick a key. The pick is shown only, game controls stay the same.

body.text: Tap a key box to rebind it.

intro.text: Tap the square, the hue bar, a dye, or type six hex keys.

note.text: Preview shows the nearest prebuilt color, the hex is exact.

intro.text: Tap an item on the ring. PC mouse hover lights it, phones pick on tap.
Start the tutorial. Each step highlights one part of this mock screen.
Bar heights come from the server in 2 px steps.
The line is drawn as 4 px columns the server sizes in 2 px steps.

note.text: Rotated segments are not possible, so the line is stepped.

intro.text: Real items drawn by the vanilla item renderer. Tap a cell to select it.
Real item icons. The server owns the coin balance and checks every purchase.
A crafting grid of real item icons. Prev and Next cycle through the recipes.
Your live figure, name and status come from the server.

note.text: Wave plays an arm animation on you and the figure. Change status cycles Online, Away and Busy.

intro.text: A lobby list. Kick removes a player, Invite brings them back.

host_note.text: The host row cannot be kicked.

intro.text: Tap a header to sort, tap it again to flip. Tap a row to select it.
Tap an arrow to expand or collapse. Tap a name to select it.

side_note.text: The server lists the visible rows.

side_note2.text: Each row reads its own slots.

intro.text: The server counts down 20 times a second and writes the time.
Tap the sticks, then draw through the dots.

rule.text: Each dot counts once, as on a phone lock screen.
